subtext: Built, rebuilt and tested by engineers who work on BMW engines every day.
Here's our practical view of the B48 across all 11 model applications.

columns.title: APPLICATIONS WE SEE:
columns.body: The B48 is one of the most widely-deployed engines we work on — 11 model lines spanning hatchbacks, saloons, SUVs and a roadster.

columns.title: WHAT WE REPLACE:
columns.body: Main bearings, connecting rod bearings, full gasket set, and timing chain components where required as standard on every rebuild.

columns.title: KNOWN ISSUES:
columns.body: No widely-reported pattern is confirmed for the B48 across any of its 11 applications. That's a genuinely different situation from several other engines in our network where a specific wear pattern is well-documented — for the B48, we don't have one to report, and we won't invent one to sound more thorough.

notice.rest: engine-specific case studies with real job details are not yet included on this page - they'll be added once a documented set of completed B48 rebuilds is available to draw from, rather than filled with placeholder examples now.
